name: AWS Textract
desc: Extract text, forms, tables, signatures, and structured data from documents using AWS Textract.

actions.name: analyze-document
actions.description: Extract text, forms (key-value pairs), tables, and signatures from a document. Supports JPEG, PNG, and single-page PDF or TIFF, uploaded directly or from S3. For multi-page PDFs, use Analyze Document from S3 (Multi-Page) instead.

actions.name: detect-document-text
actions.description: Extract plain text from a document. Faster and cheaper than Analyze Document — use this when you only need the text content without forms or tables. Supports JPEG, PNG, and single-page PDF or TIFF, uploaded directly or from S3.

actions.name: analyze-expense
actions.description: Extract structured data from receipts and invoices: vendor name, totals, tax, line items, and more. Works best with clearly formatted receipts and invoices.

actions.name: analyze-id
actions.description: Extract structured data from identity documents such as driver's licenses and passports. Returns fields like name, date of birth, ID number, and expiry date.

actions.name: analyze-document-async
actions.description: Extract text, forms, tables, and signatures from a PDF or TIFF stored in S3. Works with both single-page and multi-page documents. This action waits for processing to finish and returns all results automatically — no extra steps needed.
